signals.name: Alphabet
signals.label: Broadest whale + fresh-buying convergence continues, now with active post-13F deployment
signals.detail: Berkshire's Q2-2026 13F build was followed by concrete post-quarter action: Greg Abel deployed roughly $10B more into Alphabet and resumed share buybacks (~$4.5B, first since June 2024), reported 8-9 Aug. Duquesne/Druckenmiller initiated a new ~336,300-share GOOGL stake the same quarter. Congress remains split: Rep. Josh Gottheimer bought 24 Jul, Rep. Michael Rulli sold 24 Aug (a round trip on his own June purchase).
signals.takeaway: Institutional conviction on Alphabet has moved beyond the 13F snapshot into active, dated buying -- the single broadest whale-consensus name this cycle, even as congressional sentiment stays mixed.

signals.name: Micron
signals.label: Whale conviction remains fractured -- Soros in, Druckenmiller out
signals.detail: Soros Fund Management's Q2-2026 13F increased Micron nearly eightfold (2,824 -> 22,422 shares, ~$25.9M), while Duquesne/Druckenmiller's same-quarter filing showed a full exit of Micron alongside Intel, Broadcom, Lattice and Coherent. Bank of America and Morgan Stanley have separately named MU a top 2026 semiconductor pick on the memory/HBM supply squeeze (sold out through 2027).
signals.takeaway: A genuinely two-sided whale book on the same stock, now reinforced by sell-side conviction on the memory-supply thesis independent of either fund's position.

signals.name: Hecla Mining
signals.label: 13F cluster buying meets a concrete August catalyst -- now facing a Friday rout
signals.detail: 312 institutional investors added HL in Q2-2026 13Fs, including Two Sigma (+126.1%, ~$85.9M). HL spiked 13% on 19 Aug alongside Coeur Mining after the US Treasury doubled long-dated debt buybacks, on record Q2 production at Lucky Friday and a debt-free balance sheet -- before falling sharply (-4.4% to -4.9% intraday) in Friday 28 Aug's hawkish-Warsh-driven silver-miner rout.
signals.takeaway: Fresh institutional buying and a real August catalyst make this more than narrative, but the position now sits squarely inside the levered-silver sleeve that took the week's biggest single-day hit.

signals.name: Pan American Silver
signals.label: Large hedge-fund accumulation tied to the structural silver-deficit thesis
signals.detail: Millennium Management increased its PAAS stake +200.2% (2,401,253 shares, ~$131.2M) in a recent 13F filing, alongside the Silver Institute's 2026 outlook projecting a sixth consecutive annual global silver supply deficit. PAAS fell 3.6-3.7% intraday in Friday's hawkish-Fed-driven miner rout.
signals.takeaway: A structural-deficit thesis with real hedge-fund backing, now stress-tested by Friday's sharp but likely rates-driven (not fundamental) pullback.

signals.name: Newmont

signals.takeaway: The large-cap gold name with the most persistent multi-member congressional footprint in the portfolio's metals bucket -- a proxy for the broader precious-metals cycle now facing its first real test since the run began.
